name: Supreme x Nike Blazer SB 'Black'
story_html: Supreme teamed up with Nike SB for a luxurious twist on the Blazer, featuring quilted black leather throughout the upper. The shoe is inspired by high-end fashion houses like Chanel and Gucci, displaying a snakeskin-embossed Swoosh with gold accents throughout the aglets, tongue branding and D-ring application on the heel. Gucci’s presence also takes the form of a green and red checkered textile that appears on the back.
